Key observations from the test image:
- Strong interveinal yellowing (veins remain green, tissue between yellows)
- Dark brown necrotic wedge/V-shaped lesion at the leaf margin (lower left)
- Overall leaf yellowing progressing from margin inward

This pattern strongly suggests **Verticillium Wilt** — the V-shaped lesion from the margin and interveinal yellowing are classic. Let me confirm with the reference.

The reference images confirm my assessment. The test image matches Verticillium Wilt perfectly:
- **Interveinal yellowing** with clearly defined green veins — identical pattern to bottom-right reference panel
- **Dark brown necrotic wedge** extending inward from the leaf margin — classic V-shaped lesion
- Same white background, same leaf texture and appearance as the reference collage
